title: Acceptance probability under a density
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\varphi\colon\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\mathbb{R}$ be pointwise nonnegative with uniform average $1$, and let $f\colon\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\mathbb{F}_2$. The derandomized BLR acceptance probability is the average over uniform $x$ of the expectation under the density $\varphi$ of the indicator that the BLR test accepts $f$ on inputs $x,y$; equivalently, it is $\mathbb{E}_{x\text{ uniform}}\mathbb{E}_{y\sim\varphi}[\mathbf{1}_{\{\text{BLR accepts }f\text{ on }x,y\}}]$.
